CHILL MODE (The Solid Foundation)

At six, Taiwo learned piano by eavesdropping—siblings' lessons through the wall, notes absorbed like osmosis. Classical training felt like constraint until his father's wisdom reframed it: rules aren't walls, they're launch pads. Chill is the bedrock state. Simple arrangements where negative space does the work. Studio recordings that refuse polish because the imperfections *are* the story. Guitar, voice, maybe keys. No layering to hide behind. This is where the instrument and the body become the same thing—breath control, string tension, the physics of vibration translated through bone.
